band_verdict: BAND NOT REPRODUCED on draw 2: 0.74 vs 0.9512. The V8 C1 figure is a single-draw point estimate, not a demonstrated band. Two draws show spread, not a confidence interval — no CI claimed from n=2.

human_approval.decision: APPROVED — P1-03 finding. The C1 band is not reproduced on the second draw (0.74 vs frozen 0.9512); the V8 figure stands as a single-draw point estimate, not a demonstrated band, with no confidence interval claimed from n=2. The 26 draw-2 survivors match known blind-spot families with no new failure mode demonstrated; their per-mutant triage is prescribed follow-up, not done here. The cross-seed disposition contamination was caught before conclusion, corrected, and fixed at root with a regression test. No P0 gate criteria or V8 decision are changed.
